offering_description.value: XPEL sells paint protection films, window films, surface coatings, and film-cutting software to installers, dealerships, and vehicle owners. It also supplies window films for homes and commercial buildings and provides installation through company-operated locations and dealership programs.

primary_products.value: Paint protection films; automotive and architectural window films; ceramic surface coatings; film-cutting software; vehicle care products

primary_services.value: Protective film installation; ceramic coating application; installer training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Independent film installers, automotive detailers, vehicle dealerships, distributors, and commercial property owners; B2C: Vehicle owners and homeowners

end_markets.value: Automotive aftermarket; automotive dealerships; residential buildings; commercial buildings; marine aftermarket

revenue_model.value: product sales: Protective films, surface coatings, and vehicle care supplies; service fees: Film installation, coating application, and installer training; subscription: Access to film-cutting software and vehicle pattern libraries

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops films and coatings made by manufacturing partners for installers and dealerships; distributor: Supplies finished films, coatings, and care products to installers and dealers; service provider: Applies films and coatings for dealerships and vehicle owners; software / platform: Turns vehicle measurements into digital cutting patterns for film installers
value_chain_position.category: brand owner; distributor; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Paint protection films, window films, surface coatings, cutting software, and installation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving installers and dealership accounts; distributors / dealers: Regional distributors, independent film installers, and automotive dealerships; own locations: Company-operated installation centers; online: Company web store for vehicle care products
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Vehicle window film installations must comply with state and local light-transmission limits.
